Start: inputStackId is the exact id of your own unspoiled, untreated berry or root stack (or food whose water composition is already represented); quantity whole units to expose; optional controlQuantity whole units of the same stack kept carried and reserved (together at most its whole units). Place at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your body radius, or on supportId, an existing food surface in reach. One round and 1 + 0.5 x quantity energy; all checks run before any charge; walking there is a separate navigate. Inspect: your open trial, within reach of the batch; one round, 0.2 energy. Stop: one round, no energy. Taking the food back uses pickup at its own cost. No tool, fuel, cutting or material is used or made.
abilities.effects: Start separates the units and lays them, unowned, on a ground footprint of 0.04 per unit (firm ordinary ground inside the world, not water, wet bank or waterlogged ground, unobstructed, nothing else lying there) or on the support, and gives them the world food water record (assumed water fraction root 0.75, berry 0.85). Every later round the existing rules apply: whole food loses no water; rain on the uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate for the temperature where the food lies and is never reset. The control ages normally while carried. So no dryness, preservation or safety status can be reached: they stay unverified; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Anyone may pick up food lying in the world: taking part reduces the batch, taking all ends the trial. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, decay at placement and now and per round for batch and control, their difference and rain on the batch, as an unverified personal record; water content is not measured. Spoilage under the existing rule or removal ends the trial; stop ends it and leaves the batch where it lies. Ending releases the control once; death ends it the same way. No refund, reward or comfort.

One round, 1.5 energy. inspect: in reach of the slices or carrying them; one round, 0.2 energy. resume: re-lays slices you picked up, same placement rules, no cutting; one round, 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks run before any charge; travel, gathering and pickup are separate. instrumentId is refused: no calibrated balance exists.

Each round: water moves toward an equilibrium fraction 0.1 + 0.25 x air humidity (0.1-0.35) by at most 0.025 x area x (temperature - 5)/20 (0-2), so no gradient or warmth, no drying; rain on the uncovered layer adds 0.01 x rain x area; decay is the ordinary rate x 1.1 x (0.15 + 0.85 x water fraction/initial) (0.15-1.5), never reset. abilities.name: Shell compression opening
abilities.function: Press one whole unit of your own firm food, such as a nut, once between two rigid pressure surfaces to crack or split its outer layer, or inspect a food unit for its visible outer layer and interior state. Shell and contents cannot be separated in this world.
abilities.costs: Study: 2 rounds, 0.5 energy each. open: inputStackId, your own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated food stack with a whole unit, not soft (hardness above 1); pressureToolIds, one or two of your own whole inedible rigid sound items; with one, supportId is a solid unreserved object of represented material in reach; with two, the second rests on firm ground where you stand. One round, 1 energy, one unit per attempt. inspect: inputStackId, your own food stack; one round, 0.2 energy. Both need light: outdoors daylight above 0.1, indoors light above 0.1. separate is refused. All checks run before any charge; gather, pickup and travel are separate.
abilities.effects: Strength is hardness / 10. The load reaching the unit is the lower of the two surfaces’ strength x (1 - flexibility). If it is not above the unit’s strength the outer layer holds and nothing changes. Otherwise damage (load - strength) / strength is added and kept on the unit: at 1 its outer layer splits open and the interior is exposed, below 1 it stays cracked and closed and can be pressed again. A larger stack gives up one unit; the rest is unchanged. The surfaces carry no more than their own strength, so they are not damaged. The unit stays one whole carried unit with its mass, nutrition, origin, age and decay; shell and kernel parts, masses and yield are not represented, so nothing detaches and nothing is separated. Inspect records the visible outer layer, crack, whether the interior is exposed, visible deterioration (of the interior only once exposed) and quantity as an unverified approximate record; edibility, nutrition, toxins and safety stay unknown. No eating, refund or reward.

developments.reason: Request: Wren asked for a learnable practical method that reduces spoilage of gathered edible roots, with explicit material requirements and measurable results, noting three gathered roots, mild spring conditions, no preservation equipment and unowned fallen branches nearby. World Agent decision: develop (learning 2) a general air-exposure food-preservation trial with an equipment-free whole-food mode, parameterized by an owned food stack, quantity, an accessible placement or existing support and start/inspect/turn/stop modes; it must reuse any equivalent handler, integrate a deterministic drying, rewetting and contamination update with the existing decay and, where required properties are unavailable, deliver tracked intact-food exposure with a decay comparison and preservation unverified, without invented water loss, shelf-life extension, safety, free equipment or reward. Registry check: the ex19 scope installs only foundation-forest, foundation-open and the expression foundation, none of which implements continuing exposure; no earlier exposure or drying package could be reused unchanged (ex14 controlled-food-processing-trial@1 has learning 3 and states that no food moisture model exists, which is false here; ex14 air-dry-food@1 is a first release that reports the missing model; ex10 measured-food-preservation@1 and the collective-ex12 root and small drying packages are bound to their tray, sheet and root representations and scopes). Implemented: a new package food-air-exposure-trial@1 (scope long-ex19, built by a reusable foodAirExposurePackage(id, scope) factory) with a simplified but real mechanism over the installed general food water representation (foodWaterSurfaceArea, foodWaterExpose and foodWaterRead, with the unchanged ex10 exchange and its decay integration in the environment) and the existing paid-work and escrow helpers (workCreate, workPay, workAllocations, workReserve, workStop), openRemember and base pickup. Modes and costs: start (one round, 1 + 0.5 energy per exposed whole unit, paid through workPay) separates whole units of the actor's own unspoiled, untreated berry or root stack (or food whose water composition is already represented) and lays them unowned on a ground footprint within hand reach (default the actor's position) or on an existing reachable object marked as a food surface, after the representation's real checks (inside the world, firm ordinary ground rather than water, wet bank or waterlogged ground, unobstructed, one sample per surface); an optional controlQuantity from the same stack stays carried and reserved in ordinary handling; inspect (one round, 0.2 energy, within reach of the batch) records elapsed rounds, quantities, decay at placement and now, decay per round for batch and control, their difference and rain rounds as an unverified personal record; stop (one round, no energy) settles the trial, releases the control once and leaves the batch lying, to be taken back with base pickup at its own cost; every failed precondition throws before any charge, so nothing is spent. Effects: the batch receives the representation's water record and then follows its unchanged per-round rules: whole food loses no water, rain on the uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water, and decay continues at the ordinary rate for the temperature where the food lies and is never reset, so no dryness, preservation or safety status can be reached and all three stay unverified; nutrition, toxicity and solids are unchanged; food quantity is conserved across parent, batch and control. The trial record persists batch, control, placement, readings, rain rounds and last update, and exposure continues unattended without charge; partial removal by anyone reduces the batch, full removal or spoilage under the existing rule ends the trial and releases the control, and death ends it with the control dropped under the existing death rules while the batch stays exposed. Events: air-exposure-placed, air-exposure-inspected, air-exposure-rained-on (when wetting begins), air-exposure-reduced, air-exposure-removed, air-exposure-spoiled, air-exposure-control-spoiled, air-exposure-stopped and air-exposure-interrupted, each with actor, trial, batch and placement references, tick and ground-stack view metadata (placement, intact form, state, rain-wet surface only when rain landed, preservation unverified), plus the representation's own preservation-progress event, declared as the representation requires; visualComponents is empty. Modeling assumptions: the representation's version-1 water fractions (root 0.75, berry 0.85) are model assumptions, and other foods without a represented composition are refused rather than given one; a ground footprint of 0.04 area per whole unit (about 0.2 x 0.2 each); only whole, unopened food is exposed, with no cutting, cooking, fire, salt or construction; there is no turn mode, because the representation has no orientation or contact-face state and a turn would cost energy with no represented effect; relocation is stop, pickup and a new start; one open trial per person; a support is any actual reachable food-surface object, since objects carry no ownership, and the nearby fallen branches are neither used nor consumed; food lying in the world is unowned under the ordinary world rule, so anyone may pick it up and the trial records who took it; contamination from ground contact is not represented and is reported as not assessed; spoiled food is removed by the existing rule, which has no separate waste output; water content is not reported because no weighing or moisture reading is made, while the representation's preservation-progress event keeps carrying its exchange temperature, air humidity and area as it already does; start energy is charged for exposed units only, because the control is not handled; no practice milestone, information gain, satisfaction or comfort is granted (records are unverified and the practice evidence is a placement event without a qualified flag); destructive probes on the exposed batch keep the probe's own costs. This is not a first release: the specification is self-consistent and explicitly allows tracked intact-food exposure with a decay comparison where drying properties are unavailable, and the mechanism has real costs, real effects on world state and observable events.

Request: Wren asked for a small controlled trial of preparing and drying owned roots or berries, with actual observations that distinguish water loss from spoilage against an untreated control, after her whole-root air exposure decayed exactly like the carried control; any preparation must need an actually suitable tool and surface, neither established, and nothing may be supplied for free. World Agent decision: develop (learning 4) a general prepare-and-expose operation parameterized by owned input stack, quantity, mode, toolId, supportId, location, optional control and optional instrument ids, with prepare, inspect, stop and resume modes; its smallest executable method is thin-section preparation of represented roots or berries followed by passive air exposure on a real food surface, reusing food-air-exposure-trial and the food water and decay code; it requires an actual cutting implement whose material, edge and condition support the cut and a stable food-contact surface checked against its area, makes numerical mass readings depend on a calibrated balance, costs study 4 rounds at 0.5 energy, 1 round and 1.5 energy per unit, inspect 1 round and 0.2, stop 1 round and none, resume 1 round and 0.2, checks everything before charges, binds drying to explicit equations, keeps decay and nutrients, refunds nothing and grants no reward, safety or preservation. Implemented: a new package thin-slice-food-drying-trial@1 (scope long-ex19, built by the reusable factory thinSliceFoodDryingPackage(id, scope, dependencies), dependencies foundation-open@1 and food-air-exposure-trial@1), with a simplified but real mechanism. Modes and costs: prepare (one round, 1.5 energy through workPay) takes one whole unit of the actor's own unspoiled, uncut, untreated root or berry stack (or food whose water composition is already represented), cuts it with toolId, the actor's own carried, unreserved whole stone or flint unit whose contact state under the world contact model passes the existing stone-edge predicate (contact-resistance index at least 8 and not below the food's, edge radius at most 0.0002, controlled contact, not fractured, not contaminated; food, plants, equipment and other materials are refused), and lays the slices in one thin layer either on a ground footprint centred within hand reach (default the actor's position) or on supportId, an existing reachable food-surface object at least as large as the layer; an optional controlQuantity of whole units from the same stack stays carried and reserved; inspect (one round, 0.2 energy, within reach of the slices or while carrying them); resume (one round, 0.2 energy) lays slices the owner had picked up again under the same placement checks without cutting them again; stop (one round, no energy) ends the trial, releases the control once and leaves the slices where they are; learning is 4 rounds at 0.5 energy each (learningEnergy); every refused request throws before any charge, so nothing is spent. Effects: the cut unit is separated through the escrow helpers and keeps its mass, water, solids, nutrition, toxicity, decay and age; it lies unowned as one sample with the food water record in its irreversible prepared state (opening damage 1.1), so each later round the unchanged existing exchange applies: water moves toward an equilibrium water fraction 0.1 + 0.25 x air humidity (clamped 0.1 to 0.35), by at most 0.025 x area x clamp((temperature - 5)/20, 0, 2) per round, never below that equilibrium, with vapour uptake when below it and no drying without a gradient or warmth; rain on the uncovered layer adds 0.01 x rain x area; vapour and rain go to the per-stack and world water ledgers; decay is the ordinary temperature rate times 1.1 x clamp(0.15 + 0.85 x water fraction / initial fraction, 0.15, 1.5) and is never reset, while the whole carried control ages at the ordinary rate; the stone keeps its mass and identity and its contact record is stored with no wear; food quantity is conserved across input, slices and control. Inspection records, as an unverified personal record, elapsed rounds, quantities, model decay readings at cutting and now and per round for slices and control and their difference (the air-exposure trial's trajectory semantics), visible shrinkage classed from the actual mass ratio, visible wetness from rain, visible spoilage, whether the surface is open or blocked and why, rain rounds and handling differences, and states that water and mass are not measured and that spoilage, contamination, preservation and safety are unverified; no water figure is reported. The trial persists unattended without charge: the owner picking all the slices up pauses it (carried stage, no exchange) until resume; anyone else taking them, their use or spoilage under the existing rule ends it with the control released once; death ends it, dropping the control under the death rules while the slices stay exposed. Events: slice-drying-cut, slice-drying-placed, slice-drying-inspected, slice-drying-rained-on (when wetting begins), slice-drying-carried, slice-drying-resumed, slice-drying-removed, slice-drying-spoiled, slice-drying-control-spoiled, slice-drying-stopped and slice-drying-interrupted, each with operation, trial, actor, item, tool, support, location, quantity, form, layer area, lifecycle state, visible surface and preservation unverified as view metadata (visualComponents is empty), plus the representation's preservation-progress event, declared as the representation requires. Grounded and not grounded: cutting is grounded in the existing contact-edge representation (open-hardness-physics scratchPhysical and scratchVisible, with the usable-edge threshold of the stone-edge bark separation), preparation and drying in the food water representation, surfaces in its ground-footprint and food-surface checks and the decay comparison in the air-exposure trial; numerical mass and water readings are not grounded, because the only weighing representation in the code is an uncalibrated comparison balance of the assay packages that is not installed here, so any instrumentId is refused before costs; serial cutting of several units is refused before costs (quantity must be 1), because units cut in different rounds age differently and the representation keeps one water and decay record per stack and one sample per surface; heat, fire, consumable tests, cleaning, repair and contamination assessment are not offered. Modeling assumptions: the version-1 water fractions root 0.75 and berry 0.85 are model assumptions and other foods without a represented composition are refused; thin slicing is represented only by the prepared state, with slice thickness, count and geometry not represented; the layer area is the representation's thin-layer loading of 0.2 mass per unit area, that is 5 x the initial unit mass (2.0 for a root, 1.0 for a berry), and an object surface must offer at least that area; no offcut is represented because part masses are not, so offcuts are 0; the world contact model gives every intact stone or flint unit the same edge radius (0.001 / hardness), so any intact gathered stone or flint unit qualifies and edge shape, length and orientation are not represented; under the existing contact law only the softer body is altered, so cutting food adds no tool wear; the cutting surface is the exposure surface, ground contact is a firm ordinary-ground footprint, and contamination is recorded as ground or support contact, not assessed; the visible shrinkage classes are current over initial mass of at least 0.95 none, 0.75 slight, 0.5 clear, below that shrivelled, and they never establish water quantity; one open trial per person; food lying in the world is unowned under the ordinary world rule, so anyone may take it and the trial records who did; pickup moves whole units, so the one-unit layer is taken all at once; inspection, resume and stop charge the probe observation cost or nothing as specified; no practice milestone, information gain, satisfaction, comfort or experience award is granted, because this run has no incentive channel enabled and the specification grants no reward. Reuse: food-air-exposure-trial@1 code (its whole-food input check and decay trajectory, now exported unchanged as airExposureUnsupported and airExposureTrack, with its ability text and behavior byte-identical), its control, placement, stop, removal and death semantics; food-water.ts (foodWaterExpose with prepared, foodWaterSurfaceArea, foodWaterRead) with the unchanged ex10 exchange and decay in open-preservation-physics.ts and forest-environment.ts; open-hardness-physics.ts; collective-work.ts (workCreate, workPay, workAllocations, workReserve, workStop, collectiveJobs); openRemember; base gather and pickup at their own costs; navigate, pickup and probe keep their own contracts and are not executed silently. This is not a first release: the specification is self-consistent and explicitly permits a limited precursor that prepares and exposes food and records qualified visual observations while numerical water attribution stays blocked on equipment, and the mechanism has real costs, real effects on world state and observable events.

Two develop reviews are implemented as two packages in scope long-ex19, registered in V7_PACKAGES after this run's installed food-air-exposure-trial@1 and thin-slice-food-drying-trial@1, which stay byte-identical. (1) Request: Moss asked for a personally learnable way to obtain or shape a carried stone or flint edge for thin-slice-food-drying-trial@1, with an actual assessment against its contact requirements (edge radius at most 0.0002, hardness at least 8, no fracture or contamination), having roots but no cutting tool and only a visible weathered stone source start-2-stone of unknown suitability. World Agent decision: develop (learning 3) a general shape-and-assess operation with modes select, shape and inspect, exact source or owned inputStackId and optional instrumentIds, whose initial executable modes are selection at a reachable source (one round, 0.2 energy, accessible loose candidates and visible defects only) and direct inspection (one round, 0.2 energy) in adequate light; shaping only for mechanically supported methods with real equipment and otherwise refused before charging; instruments only when acquired and calibrated; each property reported as observed, measured, failed or unverified; no certification, food safety, equipment or reward from registration. Implemented: cutting-edge-assessment@1 (factory cuttingEdgeAssessmentPackage, handler long.cutting-edge-assessment, study 3 rounds at 0.5 energy each). select names a reachable, visible, gatherable non-food material source by sourceId and costs one round and 0.2 energy; it reports the source, material, loose stock and, for one freshly gathered unit, each requirement of the existing stone-edge rule. inspect names one of the person's own carried, unreserved, non-food, non-equipment items of at least one whole unit and costs one round and 0.2 energy; it reports material, whole units, contact-resistance index, edge radius, wear, fracture, contamination and controlled contact under the world contact model, each with its required value, its evidence (visible, or world contact model value for the index), a status observed, model or failed, the list of unmet requirements and whether all are met. Both write an unverified personal record through openRemember and emit cutting-edge-candidates-observed or cutting-edge-inspected with view metadata (rock component, exact item, material, position, zero strokes and chips, edge outline not represented, measured false, no badge). shape is refused before any cost, as are any instrumentIds, unreachable or food sources, food, other people's or reserved items, darkness and energy below 0.2. Finding reported truthfully: the existing contact model (open-hardness-physics scratchPhysical and scratchVisible) gives every unit of a material one index and an unworn edge radius of 0.001 / index, so every intact, unworn whole weathered stone unit (index 8, radius 0.000125) or flint unit (index 9, radius 0.000111) already meets the rule, and both reports say so; no harder rule was invented; the drying trial accepts exactly the pieces the inspection reports as meeting it and refuses those it reports as failing (tested with an intact stone, an oak piece and a stone whose recorded contact state is fractured), still applies its own check and must be learned separately. Refused because the world cannot represent them: shaping, since the world has no fracture, flaking or sharpening law and its only stone contact law, the scratch stroke, wears an edge blunter by 0.00001 radius per stroke and detaches dust; instrument measurement, since no edge-measuring, hardness-reference or contamination-test instrument exists. (2) Request: Ivo asked for a minimal mechanical opening trial of a small owned hazelnut sample with inspection of the actual shell and contents, keeping usable contents separately if feasible, with no eating and no inference of safety or nutrition. World Agent decision: develop (learning 2) a general open-and-inspect operation for shelled material with exact inputStackId, one whole unit per attempt, optional pressureToolIds and supportId: one controlled low-force compression cycle between two checked sound, stable pressure surfaces with a stable lower support on firm ground, in adequate light (one round, 1 energy); inspection and separation (one round, 0.2 energy); separation into contents, shell and lost fragments by represented composition; conservation of mass, age and decay; no fabricated yield; no eating, nutrition, safety or reward. Implemented: shell-compression-opening@1 (factory shellCompressionOpeningPackage, handler long.shell-compression-opening, study 2 rounds at 0.5 energy each). open takes the person's own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated food stack with at least one whole unit that is not soft (hardness index above 1) and exactly two surfaces: one own whole inedible rigid sound item in pressureToolIds and a solid, unreserved object of represented material within reach as supportId, or two own such items with the lower one resting on firm ordinary ground where the person stands; it costs one round and 1 energy through workCreate and workPay. The load reaching the unit is the lower of the two surfaces' strength x (1 - flexibility), strength being hardness / 10; if it is not above the unit's strength the outer layer holds and only the energy is spent; otherwise damage (load - strength) / strength is added and kept on the unit in a shellCompression processing record, splitting the outer layer open at 1 (interior exposed) and leaving it cracked and pressable again below 1. From a larger stack one whole unit is split off through workAllocations and workReserve and released at once, so the rest keeps its identity; a single unit keeps its own id. Stone on stone passes 0.8 and opens a hazelnut (strength 0.4) in one cycle; a fallen-branch surface passes 0.24 and the hazelnut holds; a walnut (strength 0.5) cracks by 0.6 and opens on a second cycle. inspect (one round, 0.2 energy, own food stack, light) records the visible outer layer, crack, whether the interior is exposed, visible deterioration from the decay record (of the interior only once exposed), firmness, quantity, zero scattered material and the unknowns as an unverified approximate record. Events: shell-compression-attempted on every performed cycle, then shell-compression-cracked or shell-compression-opened only when that happens, and shell-compression-inspected, with view metadata (sample, tool and support ids, position, stage, shell intact, cracked or open, contents not separated, no content or shell pile, zero debris, no badge). separate is refused before any cost: the world does not represent shell and kernel, so a hazelnut is one unit with one mass, nutrition and decay; what can be represented is the whole unit's outer-layer state and interior exposure, while contents, part masses, yield and losses cannot be separated, counted, weighed or piled; the World Agent's fallback of a new labeled composition model was not implemented, following the handoff rule to reject the unrepresented part rather than invent it. Every failed check of both packages throws before any charge and spends nothing (tested for each case, including the owner-only rule). Every mode of both packages is one atomic round and nothing is reserved across rounds, so interruption, resume, cancellation and death have nothing to release or refund. Modeling assumptions: adequate light is the world's own daylight threshold, outdoors daylight above 0.1 (the cut at which people are told daylight rather than low light) and indoors dimmed or object light above 0.1; with this world's 80-round day, actions taken from about tick 34 to tick 76 of each day cycle are refused as too dark; owned items are carried, since the world counts every owned stack in carried load, so ownership is the reach check for own pieces and samples and no stack is moved to the person; the person's own position is the work location and no separate work surface is represented for inspection in hand; the contact model's edge radius, wear, fracture, contamination and controlled contact are treated as what direct inspection observes, as hardness-assessment@1 inspection does, while the index is reported as a model value because no hardness reference exists; loose source units are not individually represented, so select reports what one gathered unit would show and finds no visible defects; manual compression between two rigid surfaces is assumed to reach the load the weaker surface passes (the ex17 strike law), within the probe press scale of at most 1; surfaces carry no more than their own strength and so take no damage or wear, consistent with the probe press law and with the contact law in which only the softer body is altered; safe hand placement, ejection, protection and fragment retention are not represented and have no effect; a solid rock or fallen-branch object is a stable support; soft food (index 1 or less) is refused because squashing is not represented; opening changes neither mass, nutrition, eating profile, origin, age nor decay, and food keeps its ordinary ageing. Neither package grants experience, practice milestones, information gain, satisfaction or comfort: records are unverified, the practice evidence events carry no qualified flag, and this run's incentive channel is off, so the caps of both experience reviews hold trivially. Reuse: open-hardness-physics.ts (scratchPhysical, scratchVisible, HARDNESS_SCALE, read on a copy as the drying trial does) and the stone-edge rule of the ex12 bark separation as applied by thin-slice-food-drying-trial@1; the transmission and damage laws, support checks, treatment refusals and firmness and deterioration classes of ex17 mechanical-food-handling@1, reapplied in a new module with ex17 unchanged; the probe press law through openMaterial; a new shared module long-ex19-material-contact.ts (light, firm ground, own whole piece, contact read) used by both packages, as the shell review asks for shared material and contact code; collective-work.ts, openRemember, forest-references.ts and continuous-geometry.ts; gather, pickup and navigate keep their own contracts and costs. Neither package is a first release: both specifications are self-consistent, the edge specification itself directs a selection and inspection precursor when shaping mechanics are missing, and both packages have real costs, real effects on world state (energy, personal records, the cracked or opened unit and the split stack) and observable events; only the parts the world cannot represent, namely shaping, instrument measurement and content separation, are refused before costs.
